verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Fathom surfacing past meetings with the same attendees, or a brief of open threads, before an upcoming call. What exists is adjacent: an API meetings filter by company domain is a developer building block, and cross-call search, a conversational assistant and Deal View are related features. None of these is a documented pre-call prep capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call
